purpose: Coverage inventory for the EUROMOD Belgium BE_2025 model surface against Belgium RuleSpec. EUROMOD is an executable comparison oracle, not legal authority; statutory and regulatory RuleSpec modules must still cite upstream Belgian law.
coverage_claim: Axiom’s active Belgium comparison surface targets only outputs stated in public-policy documents. The documentary hard cut has retired nineteen former suites, including the employee-worker aggregate, pensioner aggregate, cross-region family-benefit aggregates, and supplied-centimes gross property-tax aggregate. Direct documentary employee, pensioner, regional family-benefit, and regional property-tax components may remain encoded without being claimed as live oracle outputs. Any annualization, regional selection, household aggregation, or EUROMOD income-list composition belongs in this external layer and requires a fresh direct comparison before it can become current evidence.

oracle_configuration.configuration_note: Live synthetic comparisons use the BE_2024_c1_2015_03_e2 dataset configuration and BE_training_data as the template dataset so EUROMOD's Belgian uprating and policy switches run while synthetic rows retain the training schema.

oracle_output_coverage.evidence: RuleSpec encodes the ONSS DmfA 2025 Q1 ordinary employer bridge for private-sector commercial employers from the 19.88 percent basic tax-shift rate, the 4.27 percent wage-moderation formula on remuneration and the basic employer contribution, the 1.69 percent 1.60-contribution including wage moderation, and the official ONSS 2025 FFE workbook parenthesized less-than-20-worker rate of 0.18 percent. The 2026-07-04 live comparison bridges EUROMOD's returned annual yem into Axiom and shows EUROMOD tscer_s at exactly 26.75 percent of gross for both 30k and 60k worker cases, while Axiom returns the source-backed 26.868876 percent path. The residual is filed upstream as ec-jrc/JRC-EUROMOD-software-source-code#11 because BE_2025 uses 0.06 percent and 0.12 percent company-closing-fund rates instead of the official ONSS 2025 workbook's 0.18 percent and 0.23 percent rates including wage moderation.
oracle_output_coverage.remaining_gap: Exact EUROMOD parity is blocked by the filed employer-SSC parameter issue rather than an Axiom statutory encoding gap. Broader employer-contribution parity still needs special employer categories, structural reductions, manual-worker vacation contributions, at-least-20-worker cases, and full household contribution bases.

oracle_output_coverage.evidence: RuleSpec encodes Royal Decree No. 38 Article 12 self-employed contribution rates, including the statutory 20.50 percent first-bracket rate and 14.16 percent second-bracket rate, and Article 13 pension-age rates. axiom-oracles maps the selected annual contribution to EUROMOD tscse_s, bridges EUROMOD's returned annual yse into Axiom gross income, and uses the BE_2025 Article 14 factor implied by EUROMOD's current Article 12 threshold. The 2026-07-03 live comparison under dataset BE_2024_c1_2015_03_e2 with template_dataset BE_training_data matches all four main-activity cases: 5k floor, 30k first bracket, 60k high first bracket, and 120k capped/second-bracket case. The same report intentionally shows three residuals for secondary and post-pension cases because EUROMOD treats the Article 12 section 2 and Article 13 section 1 thresholds as deductible allowances; that model issue is filed upstream as ec-jrc/JRC-EUROMOD-software-source-code#6 and tracked in euromod_issues.json.
oracle_output_coverage.remaining_gap: Broader self-employed SSC parity still needs student, spouse-helper, starter, survivor-pension, prior-year-income, and expense/loss cases. Secondary activity and post-pension cases are encoded and oracle-exercised, but exact EUROMOD parity is blocked by the filed threshold-allowance issue rather than an Axiom statutory encoding gap.

oracle_output_coverage.evidence: RuleSpec encodes Law of 30 March 1994 Article 108's annual household special social-security contribution schedule and maps it to EUROMOD tsceesp_s. The oracle suite bridges EUROMOD's returned annual il_taxabley into RuleSpec's Article 107 household-income input. The 2026-07-04 live comparison under dataset BE_2024_c1_2015_03_e2 with template_dataset BE_training_data matches 3/7 cases: the 10k zero case, the 30k single-worker middle-band case, and the 55k single-worker fourth-band case within the 1 EUR tolerance. The 80k single-worker case and all three joint-assessment cases intentionally show residuals tracked as ec-jrc/JRC-EUROMOD-software-source-code#7: EUROMOD's BE_2025 tsceesp_be schedule uses misstated single thresholds/cap behavior and appears to swap the joint 1.3 percent band with the plateau band.
oracle_output_coverage.remaining_gap: Broader special-contribution parity still needs Article 107 income construction from full PIT variables, Article 109 payroll withholding comparisons, Article 110 settlement/refund comparisons, treaty exclusions, special worker categories, and resolution of the filed EUROMOD Article 108 schedule issue.

oracle_output_coverage.meaning: Flemish care insurance / social protection contribution
oracle_output_coverage.evidence: RuleSpec computes the 2025 Flemish Social Protection ordinary and reduced annual premiums from Article 68: 54 EUR and 27 EUR base amounts multiplied by the official Statbel April 2024 / April 2020 health-index ratio on base year 2013 and rounded to the nearest euro, yielding 64 EUR and 32 EUR. axiom-oracles maps the annual premium to EUROMOD tci_s and adds BE_2025 adult Flanders cases with drgn1=2: a high-income ordinary adult with brv_s=0 and a reduced-premium adult whose bsa input triggers EUROMOD brv_s>0. The 2026-07-03 live comparison under dataset BE_2024_c1_2015_03_e2 with template_dataset BE_training_data returns EUROMOD tci_s = 64.00 and 32.00, matching Axiom exactly.
oracle_output_coverage.remaining_gap: Broader Flemish Social Protection parity still needs voluntary Brussels affiliation, administrative affiliation without premium, arrears, and sanctions.

oracle_output_coverage.evidence: RuleSpec encodes the Flemish Codex decree of 20 May 2022 and the Flemish Government implementing order consolidated as of 1 January 2025: lower monthly gross threshold 2,115 EUR, upper threshold 3,114.99 EUR, maximum full-time annual base 650 EUR, degressive floor 50 EUR, 50 EUR fixed top-up when payable, and 50/10 EUR full-time/part-time small-payment thresholds. The 2026-07-04 live axiom-oracles comparison maps this output to EUROMOD bwkrg_s, bridges EUROMOD yemeq_s into Axiom monthly gross, and runs five full-time worker cases plus two part-time probes. The Brussels non-Flanders case and tiny part-time suppression case match at zero; the four Flanders full-time worker cases and one low-wage half-time worker case intentionally show residuals of 100.00, 100.00, 168.9985, 168.9952, and 75.00 EUR because EUROMOD BE_2025 bwkrg_be uses 1,800/2,500 EUR wage thresholds, a 600 EUR maximum, a 20 EUR full-time suppression threshold, and no 2025 fixed top-up. This is filed upstream as ec-jrc/JRC-EUROMOD-software-source-code#10.
oracle_output_coverage.remaining_gap: Broader part-time and partial-year jobbonus cases, frontier workers, administrative payroll reconstruction, and resolution of the filed EUROMOD stale-parameter issue remain outside exact parity.

oracle_output_coverage.evidence: RuleSpec encodes CIR 92 Article 518 cadastral-income indexation from the current FisconetPlus consolidated statute and official SPF Finances annual coefficients, including nearest-euro rounding after applying the 2025 coefficient 2.2446. The 2026-07-04 live BE_2025 synthetic comparison maps that output to EUROMOD khooo_s and runs two property-owner cases. The 5000 EUR non-indexed cadastral-income exact-multiple case matches at 11223 EUR; the 1000 EUR case intentionally shows EUROMOD khooo_s = 2244.6000000000004 against Axiom 2245 because BE_2025 tprhm_be computes khooo_s as khooo * $khooo_uprate without the Article 518 nearest-euro rounding step. That residual is filed upstream as ec-jrc/JRC-EUROMOD-software-source-code#14.
oracle_output_coverage.remaining_gap: Exact indexed cadastral-income parity is blocked by filed upstream EUROMOD issue #14. Broader cadastral-income parity still needs cadastral-income establishment, reassessment, Article 15 proportional reductions, regional reductions, and household/property ownership allocation.

oracle_output_coverage.evidence: RuleSpec exposes a dense-executable social-integration income-support output that composes Article 3/4 eligibility, Article 14/15 selected amounts, supplied Chapter II resources, and cent-presented monthly support into an annual amount. axiom-oracles maps that concept to EUROMOD bsa_s and supplies the official 2025 monthly category amounts used by the BE_2025 model. The 2026-07-04 live comparison under dataset BE_2024_c1_2015_03_e2 with template_dataset BE_training_data matches both cases exactly: isolated adult no resources at 15770.40 EUR/year and single parent with one dependent child/no resources at 21312.84 EUR/year.
oracle_output_coverage.remaining_gap: Broader social-assistance parity still needs itemized resources, cohabitant resources, earned-income disregards in live cases, CPAS equity/procedure surfaces, and additional household composition variants.

oracle_output_coverage.evidence: RuleSpec now exposes a dense-executable GRAPA annual output that composes Article 6 selected maximum amount, Article 7 resources, and Article 11 resource reduction. axiom-oracles maps that concept to EUROMOD bsaoa_s and adds a BE_2025 isolated-senior no-resources suite case using EUROMOD's 2025 current monthly Cat2 amount, 1,580.37 EUR, as a supplied current-amount bridge. The 2026-07-03 live comparison temporarily patches the BE_2025 bsaoa_be policy switch on in a model XML overlay and returns EUROMOD bsaoa_s = 18,964.44 and Axiom belgium_grapa_income_guarantee_for_elderly_annual_amount = 18,964.44.
oracle_output_coverage.remaining_gap: Broader GRAPA parity still needs current-amount source ingestion, detailed delegated resource exclusions, property and capital resource calculations, cohabiting cases, and administrative eligibility surfaces.

oracle_output_coverage.meaning: ordinary unemployment benefit (PART SIMULATED; bun_be switched on per run)
oracle_output_coverage.note: The former unemployment pilot pipeline mixed documentary benefit rules into a comparator-shaped payable output. It has been removed from active comparison configuration; documentary unemployment modules remain available for a future external composition.

oracle_output_coverage.evidence: RuleSpec encodes Royal Decree of 3 July 1996 Article 216 ordinary maternity indemnity rates: 82 percent of uncapped daily remuneration for the first 30 working days for Article 86 item 1 a/b workers and 75 percent of Article 113-capped daily remuneration after day 30. axiom-oracles adds BE_2025 mother/newborn household cases, enables EUROMOD extension switch PBE=on for bmact_be, and bridges EUROMOD's returned annualized yem to Axiom uncapped daily remuneration as yem / 312. Under-cap cases bridge the same daily amount into the Article 113-capped input; the high-wage case keeps the capped daily input supplied at the BE_2025 Article 113 daily cap of 183.13 while bridging only uncapped daily remuneration. The 2026-07-05 live comparison under dataset BE_2024_c1_2015_03_e2 with template_dataset BE_training_data matches the 30k, 45k, and 60k employed mother/newborn cases exactly after EUROMOD uprating.
oracle_output_coverage.remaining_gap: Maternity eligibility and waiting-stage reconstruction, unemployment and self-employed maternity branches, protection-period scheduling, multiple-birth and hospitalization extensions, payment allocation, and upstream ingestion of the indexed Article 113 cap source remain supplied or outside the verified slice.

oracle_output_coverage.evidence: RuleSpec encodes Law of 3 July 1978 Article 30 first three employer-paid days plus Royal Decree of 3 July 1996 Article 223bis at 82 percent for the final seventeen days. axiom-oracles adds BE_2025 father/newborn household cases, enables EUROMOD extension switch PBE=on for the bpact_be policy, and bridges EUROMOD's returned annualized yem to Axiom uncapped daily remuneration as yem / 312. Under-cap cases bridge the same daily amount into the Article 87-capped input; the high-wage case keeps the capped daily input supplied at the BE_2025 daily cap of 183.13 while bridging only uncapped daily remuneration. The 2026-07-05 live comparison under dataset BE_2024_c1_2015_03_e2 with template_dataset BE_training_data matches the 30k, 45k, and 60k father/newborn cases exactly after EUROMOD uprating.
oracle_output_coverage.remaining_gap: Eligibility/filiation/cohabitation reconstruction, working-history gates, allocation, leave scheduling, and upstream ingestion of the indexed Article 87 cap source remain supplied or outside the verified slice. Broader parental leave, incapacity, and disability parity remain open.

domain_coverage.oracle_status: The Article 51 Python suite now uses only the legacy documentary article_51_forfaits module and direct documentary inputs. It has no current comparison report or conformance binding while the signed canonical page-121/page-122 migration and a fresh run are pending. End-to-end tin_s, marital-quotient, pensioner, replacement-income, self-employment, and EUROMOD income-list compositions have been retired from active atomic-RuleSpec comparison surfaces.

Current reports cover employer social contributions, self-employed contributions, the Article 108 special contribution, and the Flemish social-protection premium. Documentary employee-contribution, monthly work-bonus, and pensioner contribution components remain encoded, but the worker and pensioner reports were retired because they required generated annual aggregates; they are not current oracle evidence.

Documentary regional birth-allowance and child-benefit entitlement and amount modules remain encoded. The cross-region, annualized, social-supplement, and household aggregates and their reports were retired, so this domain has no current oracle suite.

bsa_s live-verifies exactly for isolated adult and single-parent dependent-child no-resources cases using the 2025 current monthly amount bridge. bsaoa_s live-verifies exactly for the isolated no-resources senior when the oracle runner temporarily patches the BE_2025 bsaoa_be policy switch on in a model XML overlay.
The source-backed Flemish jobbonus suite remains active. The composed bun_s unemployment pilot was retired; future unemployment comparison must compose documentary legal outputs externally.

bmact_s live-verifies the BE_2025 mother/newborn household suite for ordinary employed maternity rest when EUROMOD extension switch PBE=on enables the bmact_be policy. RuleSpec composes Article 216 first-30-day 82 percent and after-30-day 75 percent indemnity days, while the oracle bridge feeds EUROMOD's annualized yem into uncapped daily remuneration as yem / 312; the under-cap cases also bridge that amount into the Article 113-capped input, and the high-wage case supplies the BE_2025 Article 113 cap value of 183.13. bpact_s also live-verifies father/newborn birth-leave cases with the same PBE switch, including a high-wage Article 87 cap case supplied at 183.13. Disability/incapacity, parental leave, maternity unemployment and self-employed branches, upstream cap-source ingestion, and broader leave scheduling remain open.

khooo_s remains a current direct comparison of CIR 92 Article 518 indexed cadastral income and retains the visible EUROMOD rounding residual. The former gross property-tax report required deleted routing and supplied-centimes aggregate modules and is archived; surviving regional tax components are not claimed as current tprhm_s evidence.
EUROMOD standard income-list outputs and uprating machinery are oracle-side comparison concepts. They are not exported from atomic RuleSpec; any aggregate comparison belongs in this external layer.

dispositioned_parity.note: Raw = exact per-comparison matches across current top-level be-* dashboard suites. Reports archived under dashboard/public/data/historical are evidence only and are excluded. Explained adds mismatches carrying a schema-validated disposition (explained residuals, upstream engine gaps, bridge artifacts) from active dispositions/<suite>.yaml.
